og.title: Laptop Repair Help | Modern Tech
og.description: Common laptop symptoms explained, with links to the parts that usually fix them.

page.heading: Not Sure What's Wrong With Your Laptop?
page.intro: Start with the symptom below that matches what you're seeing. Each one points you to the part category that usually fixes it — or message us directly and we'll help you diagnose it.

topics_copy: Detailed step-by-step articles for each symptom are coming soon. For now, each card links to the part category most likely to fix it.

topics.title: Laptop Won't Charge
topics.desc: Charging light doesn't come on, or the laptop only runs while plugged in. Usually the charger, the battery, or the DC jack.

topics.title: Battery Drains Fast Or Won't Hold Charge
topics.desc: Laptop dies quickly even when fully charged, or the battery percentage drops suddenly. Almost always a worn-out battery.

topics.title: Screen Is Cracked, Flickering Or Blank
topics.desc: Visible cracks, flickering, lines, or a black screen with the laptop otherwise powering on. Usually the screen panel itself.

topics.title: Keys Not Working Or Sticking
topics.desc: One or more keys unresponsive, sticking, or the whole keyboard not registering input. Usually a keyboard replacement.

topics.title: Screen Wobbles Or Hinge Feels Loose
topics.desc: The screen doesn't stay in position, or you hear cracking near the hinge when opening or closing the lid. Usually a hinge kit.

topics.title: Laptop Overheats Or Fan Is Loud
topics.desc: Laptop gets hot, shuts down under load, or the fan runs loud constantly. Usually a worn cooling fan or blocked airflow.

topics.title: Casing Is Cracked Or Broken
topics.desc: Visible cracks or missing pieces on the laptop body, palm rest or bottom cover. Usually a casing or palm rest replacement.

ask_direct.heading: Symptom Not Listed?
ask_direct.copy: Describe what's happening on WhatsApp — including any error messages or sounds — and we'll help you figure out which part you need before you order anything.
